title: Philadelphia Hop-On Hop-Off Sightseeing Tour by Open-top Bus
includes: Up to 25 stops to Hop-on and Hop-off
Hop on Hop off Tour of Philadelphia
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please advise at time of booking if wheelchair assistance is required
policies: Schedules may differ slightly during peak and off-peak times
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Philadelphia on this hop-on hop-off tour! See the top Philadelphia attractions including the Liberty Bell, Independence Hall and the Betsy Ross House while touring the city in a fun, fast and scenic way. Enjoy a ride on an open-top, double-decker bus, with our Hop on Hop off tour during your stay in Philadelphia.
